prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity game HUD visual study, ONE full-screen 16:9 gameplay mockup, target canvas 1920x1080, flat front-on digital image without monitor frame, no collage.
Primary request: create a beautifully crafted proposed responsive HUD for Diablo 1 reconstructed in 3D, in Portuguese. The UI is the subject. Make a realistic finished UI design mockup, rather than wireframes.
Scene/backdrop: illustrative 3D Tristram village with modest timber and stone thatched cabins, crooked leafless trees, muddy brown paths, a small stone well, candle amber from one window, charcoal grass, dark overcast sky feeling. Elevated isometric view looking down about 50 degrees, small armored warrior near center. Restrained late-1990s dark fantasy atmosphere, simple believable village geometry, muted details. This is a newly generated atmospheric backdrop, NOT a claim about current game visuals. Keep the path and the central play area unobstructed.
UI design system: aged iron and blackened pewter, narrow engraved gothic bevels, worn dark stone, tiny antique brass highlights, warm ivory labels. Red blood globe for health and deep blue globe for mana held by restrained sculpted gargoyle supports. No giant ornament or full-width opaque stone slab. UI edge definition and readable typography have more contrast than backdrop. Decorative serif only for titles; crisp very readable small humanist text for numbers/controls.
Composition: very large unobstructed world area. A compact bottom center HUD island about 860 pixels wide and 156 pixels high, anchored 24 px above bottom. Health globe at left end and mana at right end, diameter about 112 px. Directly under globes readable labels "VIDA 84 / 120" and "MANA 36 / 65". Between globes TWO orderly rows. Upper row: contextual left mouse sword action and four small spell shortcut icons clearly labeled "F5", "F6", "F7", "F8"; right mouse selected spell icon with label "Bola de fogo". These four are shortcuts for changing the active spell, not cooldown skills. Lower row: EXACTLY eight belt potion squares in ONE row, key numbers "1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7", "8", some red and blue potions, one scroll, two empty dark slots. Single bottle or scroll per cell, never stack counters. No cooldown dials. A subtle thin experience line under belt, no stamina bar.
Bottom right, separate compact utility row with four readable icon buttons for character "C", inventory "I", quests "Q", menu "Esc". Corner does not attach to a full width panel. Top left modest location "TRISTRAM" and a quiet transient message lower at left "Poção de cura recolhida." Top right small iron framed map preview about 208px square showing only discovered paths and a player marker, title "Mapa · Tab". It represents a future layout location and should remain secondary. No permanent quest checklist.
Text (verbatim): top of image small clear editorial badge "CONCEITO DE HUD — NÃO É CAPTURA DO JOGO" and "01 · 16:9". Ensure accent marks and numeric strings are legible. UI label type at plausible 18 px physical scale for 1080p.
Constraints: preserve Diablo 1 gameplay semantics; no minimap radar enemies, no dodge, stamina, skill trees, skill cooldowns, quest tracking column, MMO bars, gamepad buttons, item rarity explosion, damage numbers, logo or new lore. Exactly 8 belt cells and 4 spell shortcut chips. No tooltips in this overview. Full artistic texture and real lighting of HUD materials, polished yet readable and restrained. Entire composition in landscape 16:9.
